_comment: Hand-authored semantic fixture (design v2 §8, 'Hand-authored semantic tests').
The characterization oracle preserves existing bugs by construction -- that is
its job -- so it cannot tell anyone whether the semantics are RIGHT. These
eleven curated records and two pool rows are small enough that every expected
answer in cases.js is derived by reading the fixture, never by running the code
and writing down what came out.
Each record exists to force one distinction. Do not add fields casually: a
record that carries an incidental value can silently satisfy a case it was not
meant to, and the case stops testing anything.
Sort order at importance 0, hand-derived, sorting by importance:
c1 p1 p2 t1 t2 p4 p5 p3 p6 r1 r2 W999
W999 r1 p1 p2 c1 t1 t2 p4 p5 p3 p6 r2

curated._why: The fully-populated case: two use cases (so it duplicates under grouping), one component, one industry, one academic US affiliation, a citation count.
curated.title: Alpha health study
curated.summary: A study of privacy-preserving health data sharing.

curated._why: Shares data_sharing with p1 but a different component, so AND-across-facets can be told apart from OR-within-one. Non-academic, Europe. Same citation count as p1 so the importance sort must fall through to year.
curated.title: Beta finance study

curated._why: Empty everything. Bounded facets must give it the __none__ sentinel; authors, affiliations and both affiliation groups must NOT (NO_NONE). Its aff_region must come back EMPTY, not ['__none__'] -- the exact bug the v1 comment on NO_NONE describes.
curated.title: Gamma untyped work
curated.summary: No component, no use case, no industry, no author, no affiliation.

curated._why: One affiliations entry holding TWO semicolon-separated organizations on two continents. Forces the split, and makes the multi-region veto testable: unlighting Americas must drop it even though Europe stays lit.
curated.title: Delta shared privacy

curated._why: Academic AND non-academic at once, so lighting only Academic must veto it -- the overlap that makes one lit button read as 'only here'. Its second country is unplaceable, which must contribute NO region rather than a region that could veto.
curated.title: Epsilon mixed affiliation
curated.summary: A university and a company on one paper.

curated._why: Affiliation type literally 'unknown', which must read as non-academic, and country 'unknown', which must place it in no region at all.
curated.title: Zeta unknown type

curated._why: A repository with every attention signal, to exercise the blended weight. w = 100 + 2*10 + 5*4 + 0.1*500 = 190.
curated.title: Eta toolkit

curated._why: A repository with zero of everything. Popularity must be 0, NOT the 0.3 neutral default -- the default is for entries carrying no signal at all, and a starless repo carries one.
curated.title: Theta toolkit

curated._why: Tie partner one: same importance, same (default) popularity and same year as t2, so the sort must fall all the way through to title. 'Iota' sorts before 'Jota'.
curated.title: Iota tie

curated._why: Carries an openalex_id that the pool row W123 also carries, but a DIFFERENT url. Suppression must match on the alias, not on the displayed pointer -- a curator who replaced the OpenAlex pointer with the real source would otherwise unsuppress the row they retired.
curated.title: Lambda canonical

citation_pool_raw._why: Must be suppressed: c1 already carries this OpenAlex id, though under a different url.
citation_pool_raw.title: Kappa duplicate

citation_pool_raw._why: Must survive: nothing curated points at it. Unrated, so the default importance floor of 1 hides it and importance 0 reveals it -- the 'pool residue' behavior of §3 item 7.
citation_pool_raw.title: Mu pooled work

citation_pool_raw._why: A byte-for-byte repeat of W999's id. dedupeTail must collapse it, or the pool row shows twice and inflates the header count.
citation_pool_raw.title: Mu pooled work
